messages:
nora: Hi all  first day remote here. Two quick-ish things: who do I bug for laptop imaging/shipping, VPN access, badge/office permissions (for next week), and the canonical contact for PagerDuty/oncall + dedicated-customer escalations? Trying to build a single doc to bookmark.
josh: Welcome @nora! Short map: laptop + office badge + parking -> Michael from IT (@michael-it). VPN & cloud console access -> eng-infra. Repo permissions -> eng-platform. PagerDuty/oncall -> eng-sre. Dedicated/customer escalations -> customer-success + solutions-eng.
irene: If youe remote and need a laptop fast, DM @michael-it with your preferred model and shipping address. They usually ask for a quick approval from your manager. Badge requests need office location and a date range.
michael-it: On laptop imaging: we do self-serve order via https://redwood.internal/it/orders. For expedited requests put "EXPEDITE: new hire" in the form and CC your manager. Badges: fill the office access form and wel provision temporary QR access for your first week.
security-bot: [automated] Reminder: before we grant VPN/cloud console access please complete Security 101 training and 2FA setup. The access workflow checks training cert before issuing IAM roles.
nora: Great. For incidents I might get paged about a Dedicated customer outage. Who do I page first so I don't miss the account lead?
josh: For Dedicated customer incidents always page eng-sre first (they triage), then cc customer-success and the account's Solutions Engineer. If it's an obvious infra/VPC problem page eng-infra.
irene: Rule of thumb for quick decision: networking/credentials/storage issues -> eng-infra. Model mismatch/latency/quantization -> eng-runtime during business hours; if it's urgent page eng-sre. Dedicated incidents: cc CS and the account owner immediately.
michael-it: For badge or office access emergencies (e.g., can't get into the office for an onsite incident) we have an "office-ops" alias; include building, door ID, and your badge ID.
it-bot: [automated] If you need oncall escalation include: service, region, short impact, and a short log or command. Example payload:
```
service: inference-prod-us-east
region: us-east-1
impact: 500ms->3s p95, 30% 5xx
log-sample: tail -n 50 /var/log/inference/serve.log
```
nora: One more: who owns the central "who-to-ask" matrix so I can open an edit if somethings missing?
josh: DevEx maintains that doc; owners are @irene and @josh. Link: https://redwood.internal/devex/onboarding/people-map. If anything missing open a quick MR or ping us and wel add it.
irene: Also FYI we keep an "escalate@redwood" alias for cross-team urgent issues (billing/quota / legal). Only use for real emergencies. Finance-ops and legal monitor it during business hours.
nora: This is perfect, thank you everyone. Il submit the IT order and the perms form now and bookmark the DevEx page. :raised_hands:
